  Requests in this session's list: 1 (1 answered, 0 failed or timed out)

MEASUREMENT AVAILABILITY
  [available] First frame and connection errors: Available in both modes: the stream is reported connected only after a decodable frame arrived.
  [unavailable] Detecting a stalled stream: Not available in plain video mode: the browser reports only the first frame of a connection. Turn on Frame monitor in Settings (the camera must send an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header).

  [unavailable] Whether the picture itself changed: The dashboard counts frames that arrive; it does not compare picture content, so repeated identical images would not be noticed.
  [unavailable] Wi-Fi signal strength: Web pages cannot read it. Only the ESP32 firmware could report it.
  [unavailable] Packet loss and true network latency: Web pages cannot send pings or count packets. The request time above includes connection set-up and the camera's own processing time, so it is not Wi-Fi latency.
